name: Role login page
description: Create multiple standalone, role-gated login pages, each at its own URL with its own field labels and post-login destination.
project_description:
This functionality helps in creating multiple login pages with specific roles.

Each page is a standalone login form at its own URL (accessible only to anonymous users), with configurable username/password/submit labels, page title, CSS class, and error messages. Only users holding one of the page's allowed roles may authenticate there; on success they are redirected to that page's configured redirect path.

 -- Configuration --

 1. Configure at Administer > Configuration > ROLE LOGIN SETTINGS > Role login settings list.

 2. Click on the add login page link.

 3. Then use the login path and verify the form and try to login.
